findings.scenario: Observe whether Documented collections without tested disaster plans, independent fixity checks, format migration, geographically separated copies, or recovery exercises moves in the direction of concern: Growing untested collections, repeated disaster exposure, inaccessible formats, or failed restoration tests
findings.observationCadence: quarterly preservation review and after material storage changes
findings.measurableTrigger: A failed restore, missing provenance, unsupported format, single-copy dependency, or approaching media end-of-life
findings.boundedResponse: Inventory public and repository knowledge dependencies, verify local restoration in isolation, and record missing ownership
findings.rollback: Preserve source media unchanged, revert catalog mutations, and restore the last verified manifest
findings.authorityBoundary: Automation may inspect in-scope public or repository artifacts and run nondestructive local recovery tests. Restricted archives, third-party data, credentialed storage, destructive migration, or physical custody changes require separate authorization; escalate to a human only when access or custody is demonstrably nonautomatable.
